product_overview: A local e-commerce web application for browsing physical products, signing in with a hardcoded test account, simulating purchases, and reviewing order history. It also includes a simple admin interface for managing product entries in local UI state.
core_goals: Browse a catalog of products with key details
View detailed information for an individual product
Log in with the provided test account to access protected actions
Review past orders in order history
Manage products through a basic admin interface

features.name: Product Catalog Browsing
features.description: Lets visitors browse available products and open individual product details from the catalog.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse product cards and product metadata -> Open a product's details page -> See the selected product's detailed information
Navigate to / -> Browse product cards and product metadata -> Attempt to buy a product while unauthenticated -> See that purchasing is unavailable until login

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows users to sign in with the hardcoded test credentials and access protected areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> Access protected order history and admin pages
Navigate to /login -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit the login form -> See validation feedback and remain on the login page
After signing in, choose to log out -> Return to the unauthenticated state

features.name: Product Details and Purchase
features.description: Shows complete product information and supports a simulated purchase action for signed-in users.
user_flows: Navigate to /product/:id -> View the product image, category, price, and description -> Buy the product -> Observe a success message confirming the purchase
Navigate to /login -> Sign in with valid credentials -> Navigate to /product/:id -> View product details -> Buy the product -> Observe a success message confirming the purchase

features.name: Order History View
features.description: Displays a list of past purchases for authenticated users.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Sign in with valid credentials -> Navigate to /orders -> View order cards with product, price, and date

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Provides a basic protected interface for adding, editing, and deleting products in local UI state.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Sign in with valid credentials -> Navigate to /admin -> Fill in the product form -> Submit the form -> See the new product appear in the managed list

Navigate to /login -> Sign in with valid credentials -> Navigate to /admin -> Choose an existing product to edit -> Update the product fields -> Save the changes -> See the updated product details in the list
Navigate to /login -> Sign in with valid credentials -> Navigate to /admin -> Remove an existing product -> See the product disappear from the managed list

routes.description: Product catalog page showing product cards with view-details and buy actions
Login form that validates hard-coded test credentials
Product detail page for a selected catalog item
Protected page showing order history cards from mock data
Protected admin product management page for UI-level CRUD

features.name: Authentication Gate
features.description: Local in-memory auth context with login/logout and protected routes
user_interactions: Access protected Orders/Admin links after successful login
Click Logout to return to unauthenticated state

features.name: Product Catalog Browsing
features.description: View products loaded from mock data and navigate to product details
user_interactions: Click View Details on a product card

features.name: Product Details and Purchase Feedback
features.description: View product details by route param and trigger purchase success snackbar when authenticated
user_interactions: Navigate to a product details page
View product image, category, price, and description
Click Buy to trigger purchase flow

features.name: Order History View
features.description: Display mock order history after passing route authentication
user_interactions: View order cards with product, price, and date

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Add, edit, and delete products in local component state with snackbar notifications
user_interactions: Log in and navigate to Admin page
Fill product form and submit to add a product
Edit an existing product and save changes

known_limitations.issue: No backend API integration; all data operations use local mock data with simulated delay
known_limitations.impact: Data is not persisted and resets on refresh

known_limitations.issue: Authentication is in-memory only and uses hard-coded credentials
known_limitations.impact: Session does not persist across reloads and is not secure for production

known_limitations.issue: Buy action is disabled when unauthenticated even though handlers include login redirect logic
known_limitations.impact: Redirect path in buy handler is effectively unreachable from disabled button state

known_limitations.issue: Admin CRUD updates only local UI state
known_limitations.impact: Product changes do not propagate to catalog data source or persistent storage
